### Spacer System
**VERIFIED FINDING - Warm-Edge Spacer Technology:**

### Construction Details

On the wood windows you get a 20 year warranty on the wood material and 20 years on the seals in the glass. The warranty on the aluminum cladding will vary based on the type of cladding. It is transferable.
